summary: Covers entities supplying motor vehicle parts and accessories to original equipment manufacturers. Disclosure topics are energy management, waste management, product safety, design for fuel efficiency, materials sourcing, materials efficiency and competitive behaviour.

questions.text: What are your (1) total energy consumed, (2) percentage grid electricity and (3) percentage renewable?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total energy in gigajoules (GJ), (2) the percentage from grid electricity and (3) the percentage renewable.

questions.text: What is (1) the total amount of waste from manufacturing, (2) the percentage hazardous and (3) the percentage recycled?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total manufacturing waste in metric tonnes, (2) the percentage that is hazardous and (3) the percentage recycled.

questions.text: How many vehicles did your organisation recall?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of vehicles recalled during the reporting period.

questions.text: What is your revenue from products designed to increase fuel efficiency or reduce emissions?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report revenue in your presentation currency from products designed to increase fuel efficiency or reduce emissions.

questions.text: How does your organisation manage the risks associated with the use of critical materials?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe how risks from critical materials (supply, price, availability, regulation) are identified and managed, including mitigation strategies such as substitution, recycling or supplier engagement.

questions.text: What percentage of the products you sold are recyclable?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report the percentage of products sold that are recyclable, and state the basis (for example by weight or revenue).

questions.text: What percentage of your input materials come from recycled or remanufactured content?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report the percentage of input materials from recycled or remanufactured content, and state the basis (for example by weight).

questions.text: What is the total amount of monetary losses your organisation incurred as a result of legal proceedings associated with anti-competitive behaviour regulations?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total monetary losses for the period in your presentation currency, covering fines, settlements and other legal costs from such proceedings.

questions.text: How many parts did your organisation produce?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of parts produced in the reporting period.

questions.text: What was the total weight of parts your organisation produced?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) · Report the weight of parts produced in metric tonnes.

questions.text: What is the total area of your manufacturing plants?
questions.hint: Unit: Square metres (m²) · Report the total manufacturing plant area in square metres.
